description: Get people associated with a company — management board, supervisory board, shareholders, proxies. Returns display names, role labels, and relationship types (management, supervisory, ownership, procuration). Identify by name, KRS, or NIP.

krs.description: KRS number of the company in the Polish National Court Register (10 digits).

name.description: Company name, used when the KRS or NIP is not known.

nip.description: Polish company tax number (NIP) of the business, 10 digits.

relationship_type.description: Filter: management, supervisory (rada nadzorcza), ownership, procuration. Omit for all.

name: get_company_people
title: Get Company People & Management
